_about: u64-security, #humans 29197, condition 1: the same YubiKeys sign worker-host releases (strugglebus-release) and bus releases (strugglebus-bus-release), so the App may only ever sign in the namespace strugglebus-fleet (a constant), and only bytes that pass the strict fleet reader. These inputs are a release.toml and a bus release statement (both made up): the strict reader must refuse them, so nothing in this shape is ever put in front of the YubiKey as a fleet. The App's own test also tries each release namespace and must be refused before ssh-keygen runs.
